runs.narrative: In the dimly lit nursery, I found myself searching for purpose amidst the trays of dry compost and crackling glass. The tools of my humorless trade lay discarded on the cold floor – a trowel worn with time, a twine furred with age. I picked them up, examining them briefly before venturing forth through the door leading north towards the furnace, driven by the promise of heat and light perhaps waiting for me there. In truth, I had been little more than a seeker in this empty, silent world, a mere observer traversing the staged setting of a forgotten realm.

runs.narrative: In this journey, I found myself in a cold, long-dead furnace, where I searched the area for any signs of life or purpose. I had a trowel and twine with me, tools that hinted at the possibility of gardening or construction, even though the furnace seemed devoid of any place to grow plants or build structures. I inspected the lantern on the floor, but it was empty and its glass was sooted almost opaque, rendering it useless. With nothing left to explore, I took a moment to reflect on my actions and my place in this strange world, preparing myself for whatever challenges and mysteries might lie ahead.
